methodology.source: Morpho API + Blockscout onchain event indexes
methodology.accrued: Fee shares emitted by MetaMorpho AccrueInterest, valued at the nearest daily USD share price.
methodology.unredeemed: Outstanding fee-attributed shares valued at the current USD share price.
methodology.pending: Current-only estimate of unminted fee shares since the latest accrual, using direct RPC reads and MetaMorpho's lastTotalAssets fee formula.
methodology.redeemed: Withdrawn underlying attributed to fee shares.
methodology.attribution: Fee-first: withdrawals from a wallet mixing principal and fee shares consume fee shares first. Mixed-wallet rows are marked Review.

native.methodology: Exact fee assets emitted by each Base YieldLedger EpochYieldProcessed event. Values use the stablecoin's 6 decimals; no unfinalized-epoch estimate is included.
